title: HM Shulker Refill
description: Automatically refills blocks in your hotbar from your inventory or shulker boxes.
body:
# HM Shulker Refill

HM Shulker Refill is a practical quality-of-life mod for Minecraft Fabric.

The mod automatically refills your hotbar when the last block has been placed. It first searches for matching blocks in your inventory and then refills from shulker boxes.

Perfect for large building projects, citybuild servers, SMPs, and long survival sessions.

## Features

* Automatically refills your hotbar
* Supports inventory and shulker boxes
* Works with all placeable blocks
* Actionbar and chat messages
* Lightweight and performance friendly
* Survival friendly
* Client-side only
* For Fabric 1.21.1

## How it works

When your last block is placed, the mod automatically searches for more matching blocks:

1. First in your normal inventory
2. Then in shulker boxes

If no matching blocks are found, you will receive a chat message.

## Compatibility

* Minecraft 1.21.1
* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API

## German description

HM Shulker Refill ist eine praktische Quality-of-Life Mod für Minecraft Fabric.

Die Mod füllt automatisch deine Hotbar nach, sobald der letzte Block verbaut wurde. Dabei werden zuerst passende Blöcke im Inventar gesucht und danach automatisch aus Shulkerboxen nachgefüllt.

Perfekt für große Bauprojekte, Citybuilds, SMPs und lange Survival Sessions.
